column1: # The pictures the games may use: chosen by eye from contact sheets of well-known entries (no maps, coins, seals,
# documents, collages, or pictures that do not show their subject). Read by scripts/build-pages.ps1 for games-data.js.
# slug<TAB>puzzle set (empty = Which Came First? / Guess the Year only, when the dates allow)<TAB>order in the set
# sets: Wonders of the World | Treasures | Famous Faces | Art Through the Ages | Great Cities | Sacred Places | Great Buildings | Ships and Voyages | Statues and Sculpture | Machines and Inventions
# 28 Oct 2026: three more puzzle sets, chosen by eye on contact sheets (no grim scenes, inscriptions, modern skylines)
# A14 (5 Nov 2026): 208 more, chosen by eye from contact sheets of the most-mentioned entries with a dated picture (people only with a plain lifespan)
# 6 Nov 2026: the puzzle set Ships and Voyages, chosen by eye (the ship itself filling the picture; no close-ups of a sail, sketches or maps)
# 6 Nov 2026: the puzzle set Statues and Sculpture, chosen by eye (the work itself filling the picture, from every region; no nudes or grim subjects, as the set is in Kids mode)
# 6 Nov 2026: the puzzle set Machines and Inventions, chosen by eye from the inventions tree's pictures (the object itself, oldest first; no drawings, diagrams or portraits of inventors)
